title: SEC1: Duplicated message formatting logic in load and update paths
description:
Message formatting logic is duplicated across two functions in event.rs:

1. load_messages_for_chat (lines 315-331)
2. handle_state_change Message path (lines 480-501)

Both extract and format the same fields identically:
  - receivedAt timestamp → HH:MM
  - senderId → display name lookup
  - body text
  - Format: '{hhmm} {sender_name}: {body}'

Risk: If a solo maintainer changes the format in one place (e.g., to add delivery status, change time format, or sanitize differently), they must remember to update both. Easy to miss one, causing inconsistent display between initial load and SSE updates.

Suggested fix: Extract formatting to a helper function: format_message(msg: &Value, contacts: &HashMap) -> String
